name: The Twenty-One Day Solo, Cedar Hollow Retreat
summary: A private three-week silent retreat in a luxury cabin on a printed hour-by-hour schedule, with recorded guidance in the Tibetan tradition. No teacher on site. Beginners accepted. $6,800.
description:
Cedar Hollow offers a structured solo retreat for people who want to go long without joining a group.

**Structure**
You receive a printed schedule for each of the 21 days and follow it: sitting periods of 30 to 60 minutes, walking, recorded instruction, prostrations, rest. The days build from four hours of practice to nine. A bell system in the cabin marks each period. The programme is drawn from a traditional Tibetan preliminary-practice curriculum, adapted for lay retreatants.

**Guidance**
Pre-recorded. Each day includes audio instruction from a senior lama recorded for this programme. There is no teacher on site and no live contact; a caretaker delivers meals and can be reached by a note for practical matters only.

**Silence**
Complete for 21 days.

**Demand**
By the second week you will be practising nine hours a day, including several hundred prostrations. It is physically hard and, alone, mentally hard.

**Who**
We accept beginners, and about a third of retreatants have no prior meditation experience. The schedule and the recordings carry you. We ask that you complete our questionnaire honestly and speak with our coordinator before booking.

**Cost**
$6,800, all inclusive.
practical: Twenty-one days, any start date. $6,800 including cabin, meals, and programme. One retreatant per cabin; three cabins on the property, out of sight of each other. Cabin has heating, bath, kitchenette, practice room. Three meals delivered daily. Bring loose clothing, a journal, prostration gloves if you have them. Nearest airport Seattle; car service included. No phone or internet in the cabin.
